equity.equity_measurement: Race/ethnicity, age, sex and urbanicity describe recipient composition only; coverage is not computed by SPD. The Black case share is cited from a CDC web page; race/ethnicity is missing for 9.1% of first-dose recipients.

notes: Coverage is a hand-computed proportion, by jurisdiction, against an estimated at-risk denominator; no tests or CIs are reported. The 7–14 times higher incidence among unvaccinated persons is cited from earlier studies. Reasons for low jurisdiction coverage (accessibility, stigma) are speculative and not tied to social position.
